messages:
Priyanka Rao: hey all, day0 question: trying to tidy my "who-to-ask" list for the week. specifically: LDAP/group access, KMS key grants for test workloads, who owns model-serving rollouts, and who to ping for emergency VPN issues. any short map?
Julian Park: welcome Priyanka! quick map: LDAP/groups = infra-identity (file "Group Access" form), KMS grants = SecureOps, model-serving rollouts = eng-releases + product signoff, VPN issues = IT Support.
Priyanka Rao: great. for KMS, is there a self-serve flow or do I need an approval chain?
Marta Silva: SecureOps here 14 KMS requires an access request + justification. for test keys you can request "ephemeral test key" (72h) via the SecureOps form. production keys require an owner and a threat model.
Priyanka Rao: nice. LDAP groups  do I request a team or service account group?
Julian Park: for human access ask for team:dev-priyanka, for CI create a service account and request group svc:ci-priyanka. include SSO email and repo list.
DevEx Bot: automation: Group Access form link: /infra/templates/group-access. Required fields: sso_email, repo_list, group_type, justification.
Priyanka Rao: thanks. model-serving rollouts  who signs the model pin and who owns the canary window?
Marta Silva: eng-releases coordinates the rollout schedule and canary knobs. product must sign off on quality/regression. tag @product-approvers in the model-catalog PR and schedule a 1hr canary window with releases.
Priyanka Rao: and emergency VPN  if my laptop can't connect during onboarding, who do I call?
IT Support: IT Desk: DM us your asset tag and timezone. For immediate VPN outages ping #it-urgent or call the oncall line. Weekend response may be delayed 1-2 hours.
Priyanka Rao: helpful. one more: who can fast-track DB read access for a smoke test when I'm blocked?
Julian Park: emergency DB reads are approved by the oncall lead + People-Ops audit. File "Emergency Access" and mark P0 with a 2-hour timebox; include the query you'll run.
Priyanka Rao: perfect. thanks everyone. I'll file the group + KMS forms and tag releases for the rollout checklist. will post ticket links when done. :wave:
Marta Silva: welcome again! ping SecureOps if you need help drafting the KMS justification.
Priyanka Rao: (update) filed tickets: GROUP-3310 and KMS-778 (ephemeral key). GROUP-3310 link: https://tickets.redwood/GROUP-3310
DevEx Bot: automation: bookmarked resources added to your onboarding card: /infra/templates/group-access, /secureops/kms-requests, /releases/rollout-checklist.
Priyanka Rao: closing this thread, will reopen if the VPN or DB smoke test blocks me. thanks all :thumbsup:
